leads.title: Oregon Equality Act
leads.documents: Statewide ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing and public accommodations; defines sexual orientation to include gender identity.
leads.detail: Signed by Governor Ted Kulongoski on May 9, 2007, effective January 1, 2008. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: U.S. District Court ruling by Judge Michael McShane - May 19, 2014 same-sex marriage decision
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex marriage in Oregon by holding 2004 constitutional ban (Ballot Measure 36, passed Nov 2, 2004) unconstitutional under Equal Protection Clause.
leads.detail: Dated May 19, 2014; prior ban via Ballot Measure 36 Nov 2, 2004. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: SB704 - gay and trans panic defense abolition
leads.documents: Abolishes common-law gay panic and trans panic defense in murder, manslaughter and hate crime cases in Oregon courtrooms.
leads.detail: Passed Oregon Legislature and signed by Governor Kate Brown in May 2021, effective January 1, 2022. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: 2015 Oregon conversion therapy ban on minors
leads.documents: Bans sexual orientation change efforts (conversion therapy) performed on minors; makes Oregon third state to do so.
leads.detail: House 41-18 on March 17, Senate 21-8 on May 7, signed by Governor Kate Brown May 18, 2015, effective July 1, 2015. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: 2023 Oregon gender-affirming healthcare shield law
leads.documents: Protects and defends gender-affirming healthcare for transgender individuals, especially those entering Oregon from other states.
leads.detail: Passed House May 2023, delayed in Senate by Republican boycott, passed Senate late June with amendments, signed by Governor Tina Kotek July 13, 2023. Related Aug 2014 announcement Oregon Medicaid would cover hormones and gender-affirming care. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: Oregon non-binary legal gender recognition - 2016 circuit court ruling and DMV X policy
leads.documents: Establishes non-binary/X gender marker machinery: court can grant legal change to non-binary, DMV and birth certificates offer X.
leads.detail: Circuit court ruling June 10, 2016 described as first of kind in U.S. per Transgender Law Center; Oregon DMV X option since July 1, 2017; sex reassignment surgery not required for birth certificate since 2014. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: Parents for Privacy v. Barr litigation chain
leads.documents: Upholds transgender-inclusive policy in Oregon public schools against challenge; shows enforcement of trans student rights.
leads.detail: U.S. District Court for District of Oregon ruled against plaintiffs July 24, 2018; upheld by 9th Circuit Feb 12, 2020; U.S. Supreme Court denied certiorari Dec 2020. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals July 2025 adoption ruling
leads.documents: Rules Oregon Department of Human Services adoption requirement to 'respect, accept and support' child's gender expression and sexual orientation unconstitutional; stems from denial of adoption to Oregon woman.
leads.detail: Dated July 2025, defendant Oregon Department of Human Services. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: U.S. Department of Education Title IX investigation - June 2025
leads.documents: Federal enforcement scrutiny of Oregon Department of Education for allowing transgender women to compete in women's sports.
leads.detail: Announced June 2025. No URL in provided text.

leads.title: Casey Parks, 'The Hate Keeps Coming: Pain Lingers for Lesbian Couple Denied in Sweet Cakes Case,' The Oregonian
leads.documents: Documented incident of anti-LGBTQ denial of service (Sweet Cakes case) and lingering harm; example of discrimination enforcement climate.
leads.detail: The Oregonian, July 2, 2016, listed under Further reading. No URL in provided text.
